assertions.claim: A directory containing docforge.yaml with schema docforge.project.v1 opens through the CLI and desktop workbench.
A general project using document.md and docforge-standard completes inspect, validate, review, and build without academic metadata.
An academic project supplies a typed optional academic profile and builds with an academic template without imposing those fields on general projects.
thesisforge.yaml, thesisforge.project.v2, the thesisforge command, ThesisDocument exports, and the old workbench protocol are absent or rejected without compatibility aliases.
Default source, build, and review paths are document.md, build/document.docx, review/document.review.md, and review/document.review-map.json.
Project paths reject absolute, remote, traversal, and symlink-escape inputs while accepting safe project-relative resources.
The deterministic Markdown to ForgeDocument to validation to template to RenderPlan to DOCX pipeline preserves ordered stages, renderer boundaries, cancellation, and atomic output behavior.
CLI, HTTP, Tauri, and frontend fixtures use one versioned DocForge protocol and return matching project, source, output, progress, diagnostic, and build-result identities.
The installed macOS workbench uses neutral DocForge and document terminology for project identity, filenames, diagnostics, help, and Word preview.
Repository-owned examples, fixtures, active documentation, packaging, and CI use the DocForge project contract and neutral filenames.
